s: antaHsTayakAraH । sa ca zaqviMSahalavarRaH ॥ asyoccAraRasTAnaM tAlu । (yaduktaM sidDAntakOmudyAm । “icuyaSAnAM tAlu ॥” taTA ca SikzAyAm । 17 । “kaRWyAvahAvicuyaSAstAlavyA ozWajAvupU ॥”) tasya svarUpaM yaTA, -- “yakAraM SfRu cArvvaNgi ! catuzkoRamayaM sadA । palAlaDUmasaNkASaM svayaM paramakuRqalI ॥ paYcaprARamayaM varRaM paYcadevamayaM sadA । triSaktisahitaM varRaM tribindusahitaM taTA । praRamAmi sadA varRaM mUrttimanmokzamavyayam ॥” iti kAmaDenutantre 5 pawalaH ॥ vaNgIyavarRamAlAyAmasya leKanaprakAro yaTA, -- “UrdDvADaHkramato reKA catuzkoRamayI SuBA । nArAyaReSaviDayastAsu tizWanti nityaSaH ॥ mAtrA kuRqalinI jYeyA DyAnamasya pracakzyate ॥” tasya DyAnaM yaTA, -- “DUmravarRAM mahArOdrIM zaqBujAM raktalocanAm । raktAmbaraparIDAnAM nAnAlaNkAraBUzitAm ॥ mahAmokzapradAM nityAmazwasidDipradAyinIm । evaM DyAtvA yakArantu tanmantraM daSaDA japet ॥” * ॥ tatpraRAmamantro yaTA, -- “triSaktisahitaM varRaM tribindusahitaM sadA । praRamAmi sadA varRaM SaktimAmokzamavyayam ॥” iti varRodDAratantram ॥ asya nAmAni yaTA, -- “yo vARI vasuDA vAyurvvikftiH puruzottamaH । yugAntaH SvasanaH SIGro DUmArcciH prARisevakaH ॥ SaNKABramo jawI lolA vAyuvegI yaSaskarI । saNkarzaRaH kzapA bAlo hfdayaM kapilApraBA ॥ Agneyo vyApakastyAgo homo yAnaM pramA suKam । caRqaH sarvveSvarI DUmaScAmuRqA sumuKeSvarI ॥ tvagAtmA malayo mAtA haMsinI BfNginAyakaH । tenamaH Sozako mIno DanizWAnaNgavedinI । mezWaH somaH paktinAmA pApahA prARasaMjYakaH ॥” iti nAnAtantraSAstram ॥ (DAtvanubanDaviSezaH । sa tu divAdigaRasUcakaH । taTA ca kavikalpadrume । “divAdyo ylAdAdikaH ॥” CandaHSAstrAntargatagaRaviSezaH । taTA ca CandomaYjaryyAm । “BAdiguruH punarAdilaGuryaH ॥” asya sANketikacihnaM yaTA, .''; kAvyAdO asya praTamaprayoge lakzmIlABaH Palam । yaTA, vfttaratnAkarawIkAyAm । “yo lakzmIM rastu dAhaM vyasanamaTa lavO SaH suKaM zastu Kedam ॥”)
puM, (yAti vAtIti । yA gatO + qaH .) vAyuH । yaSaH । yogaH । yAnam । yAtA । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ sarvvanAma । yacCabdArTa iti yAvat । iti viSvaH ॥
v: yakAraH vyaYjanavarRaBedaH sparSavarRozmavarRayormaDyasTatvAt antaHsTavarRaBedaH tasyoccAraRasTAnaM tAlu jihvAgreKa tAluna IzatsparSenoccAraRAdasyoccAraRe IzatsparSa AByantaraprayatnaH “aco'spfzwAyaRastvIzat” SikzoktaH । vAhyaprayatnAH saMvAranAdaGozA alpaprARaSca । varRABiDAne'sya vAcakaSabdA uktA yaTA “yo vARI vasuDA vAyurvikftiH puruzottamaH । yugAntaH SvasanaH SIGroDUmArcciH prARisevakaH । SaNkA Bramo jawI lolA vAyuvegI yaSaskarI । saNkarzaRaH kzapA bAlo hfdayam kapilA praBA । AgneyovyApakastyAgo mohoyAtA pramA suKam । caRqaH sarveSvarI DUmrA cAmuRqA sumuKeSvarI । tvagAtmA malayomAtrA haMsinI BfNginAyakaH । Ne namaH SozakomInoDanizWAnaNgavedinI । SizwaH somaH paNktinAmA pApahA prARasaMjYakaH” । asyADizWAtfdevatADyAnaM yaTA “DUmravarRAM mahArOdrIM zaNBujAM raktalocanAm । raktAmbaraparIDAnAM nAnAlaNkAraBUzitAm । mahAmokzapradAM nityAmazwasidDipradAyinIm । evaM DyAtvA yakArantu tanmantraM daSaDA japet” । asya DyeyasvarUpaM yaTA “yakAraM SfRu cArvaNgi! catuzkoRamayaM sadA । pulAlaDUmasaNkASaM svayaM paramakuRqalIm । paYcaprARamayaM varRaM paYcadevamayaM sadA । triSaktisahitaM varRaM trivindusahitaM taTA । praRamAmi sadA varRaM mUrttimanmokzamavyayam” kAmaDenutantram । mAtfkanyAse asya hfdayanyAsyatA । kAvyAdO asya praTamaprayoge lakzmIlABaH Palam “yo lakzmIM rastu dAham” vf॰ ra॰ wI॰ ।

m: 1. य the 1st semivowel (corresponding to the vowels इ and ई, and having the sound of the English y, in Bengal usually pronounced j).
2. य m. (in prosody) a bacchic (˘ ¯ ¯), Piṅg.
3. य the actual base of the relative pronoun in declension [cf. यद् and Gk. ὅς, ἥ, ὅ].
4. य m. (in some senses fr. √ 1. या, only, L.) a goer or mover
a: यः — 1 One who goes or moves, a goer, mover. --2 A carriage. --3 Wind, air. --4 Union. --5 Fame. --6 Barley. --7 Restraint. --8 Light. --9 Abandoning. --10 One of the eight syllabic feet (गण) consisting of one short syllable followed by two long ones. --11 N. of Yama. --या 1 Going. --2 A carriage. --3 Restraining. --4 Religious meditation (ध्यान). --5 Obtaining. --6 An epithet of Lakṣmī. --7 Pudendum muliebre.
